# Programa de Ingeniería de Software Moderna

Purpose: coordinate a professional, evidence-based software engineering program across specialized repositories. The curriculum plans 540 classes in 45 parts (SE-001..SE-540). A part counts as developed only when its full content exists in content/part-NN/; the current developed and planned counts are generated in STATUS.md, catalog.json and curriculum.yaml (planned_scope). All developed classes are pending independent human editorial review; parts without content are planned only, with no published classes.

Read first:
- README.md
- STATUS.md
- curriculum.yaml
- catalog.json
- classes/README.md
- roles/README.md
- FILE_INDEX.md
- ROADMAP.md
- docs/PROGRAM-COVERAGE-AUDIT-2026-10-06.md
- manifest/repositories.json
- docs/PROGRAM-ARCHITECTURE.md
- docs/PEDAGOGICAL-STANDARD.md
- docs/COVERAGE-MATRIX.md
- docs/INTEGRATION-CONTRACT.md
- docs/REPOSITORY-BOUNDARIES.md
- sources/class-sources.json
- sources/phase3.json
- matrices/COMPETENCY-MAP.md

Rules:
- Respect repository ownership and avoid duplication.
- Verify changing claims in primary or official sources.
- Security, accessibility, testing, observability and recovery are part of done.
- Use pnpm only for JavaScript/TypeScript.
- Do not invent evidence, metrics, laws, APIs or compatibility.
- Describe the actual evidence; do not assign workflow or maturity labels to classes.
- Never present generated structure, word counts or file presence as developed teaching.
- Review every class qualitatively against docs/PEDAGOGICAL-STANDARD.md.
- Never overwrite an authored class with the scaffold generator.
- Run build_phase2.py --check and build_phase3.py --check before trusting generated counts or site pages.
